questions.question: A shopkeeper buys a book for Rs. 2,500 and marks its price at 15% above cost. He allows a discount of Rs. 345. The discount percentage is∶
questions.solution:
Cost price = Rs. 2500

Mark price of the book = 2500 + 15% of 2500 = 2500 + 375 = Rs. 2875

Discount percentage = (345/2875) × 100 = 12%

questions.question: The interest on Rs. 24, 000 in 2 years compounded annually when the rates are 8% p.a. and 10% p.a. for two successive years is∶
questions.solution:
Principle for the first year = Rs. 24000

Interest on Rs. 24000 at 8% p.a. for 1st year = Rs. 1920

Principle for 2ⁿd year = 24000 + 1920 = Rs. 25920

Interest on Rs. 25920 at 10% p.a. for 1st year = Rs. 2592

∴ Total Interest for two successive years = 1920 + 2592 = Rs. 4512

questions.question: A river is 3 m deep and 36 m wide which flows at the rate of 5 km/h into the sea. The volume of water that runs into the sea per minute is∶

questions.question: A train 100 m long running at uniform speed crosses a station which is 500 m long in 25 seconds. How long will it take for the train to pass a station that is 380 m long?
questions.solution:
Length of the train = L = 100 m

Length of the 1st station = S₁ = 500 m

Time taken by train to cross the 1st station = T = 25 seconds

∴ Speed of the train = V = (L + S₁)/T = (100 + 500)/25 = 24 m/s

Length of the 2ⁿd station = S₂ = 380 m

Time taken by train to cross the 2ⁿd station = (L + S₂)/V = (100 + 380)/24 = 20 seconds

questions.question: A swimming pool is 40 m in length, 30 m in breadth and 2.2 m in depth. The cost of cementing its floor and the four sides at Rs. 25/m² is∶

⇒ Area of four walls of swimming pool = 2(lh + bh) = 2(40 × 2.2 + 30 × 2.2) = 308 m²

⇒ Total area = 1200 + 308 = 1508 m²

⇒ Cost of cementing = 1508 × 25 = Rs. 37700

questions.question: A can do a work in 30 days, B can do the same work in 48 days. After working alone for 20 days A left and B started working, how long will B take to complete the work?
questions.solution:
**Detailed Solution****∶**

Efficiency of A = 1/30

Efficiency of B = 1/48

Work done by A in 20 days = 20/30 = 2/3

Remaining work = 1 – (2/3) = 1/3

Number of days taken by B to complete the work = (1/3) / (1/48) = 16 days

**Alternate Solution****∶**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73845c14e35814303e067d1b571b49818a154de7353c365b57080da288efbd92.png] **

Work done by A in 2 days = 20 × 8 = 160

Remaining work = 240 – 160 = 80

Number of days taken by B = 80/5 = 16 days

questions.question: Two pipes can fill a cistern in 72 and 90 minutes respectively. If both the pipes are left open how long will it take for the cistern to be half full?

Time taken by both the pipes to fill the cistern half full = (1/2) / (1/40) = 20 minutes

questions.question: The largest number of four digits that is exactly divisible by 15, 21 and 30 is∶
questions.solution:
L.C.M. of 15, 21 and 30 is 210. 

Largest four digit number is 9999.

To find the largest four digit number divisible by 15, 21 and 30 we have to divide the 9999 by 210 and subtract the remainder from 9999.

When we divide the 9999 by 210, we get the remainder 129.

∴ Required number = 9999 – 129 = 9870

questions.question: 210102 can be divided exactly by∶
questions.solution:
Sum of the digits of 210102 is 6.

We know that for a number to be divisible by 3 its sum of digits is divisible by 3.

**Divisibility rule for 4** **-** Last two digit of the number divisible by 4.

**Divisibility rule for 8** **-** Last three digit of the number divisible by 8.

**Divisibility rule for 7 –** Take the last digit of the number, double it and then subtract it from the remaining number. If the result is divisible by 7, then the original number will also be divisible by 7.

questions.question: Which least number should be added to 1000 so that the number obtained is exactly divisible by 37?
questions.solution:
To find the least number which should be added to 1000 so that the number obtained is exactly divisible by 37. We have to divide 1000 by 37 and find the remainder. Then add the difference between the 37 and remainder to 1000.

When we divide 1000 by 37 the remainder we get, is 1.

∴ Least number which should be added to 1000 so that the number obtained is exactly divisible by 37 = 37 – 1 = 36

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral such that AB is a diameter of the circle circumscribing it and ∠ADC = 144o. Then ∠BAC is equal to∶ ( {pi = frac{{22}}{7}} )

According to the question,

∠ADC = 144°

We know that in cyclic quadrilateral sum of opposite angles is 180° and the angle made by diameter at circumference is 90°.

In cyclic quadrilateral,

∴ ∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ ∠ABC = 36°

Since AB is diameter as given in the question.

In ΔACB,

⇒ ∠BAC = 180° – 90° – 36° = 54°

questions.question: A sum at a simple interest of 8% p.a. becomes 7/5 of itself in how many years?
questions.solution:
Let the sum be P and time be T.

Interest earn on the sum = (7/5) P – P = (2/5) P

Rate of interest = R = 8 %

Simple Interest = PRT / 100

(2/5)P = P × 8 × T /100

⇒ T = 5 years
